## 简体中文

- 修复 macOS 未配置 IPv6 默认路由时，开启 CN 前置分流报 `default route has no interface`、导致核心无法启动的问题。现在即使系统路由查询返回成功状态，也能识别 IPv6 默认路由不存在并继续使用 IPv4 出口；其他路由查询错误仍正常上报。

## English

- Fix CN pre-routing preventing the core from starting with `default route has no interface` on macOS when no IPv6 default route is configured. Recognize the missing IPv6 route even when the system route query reports success, and continue using the IPv4 uplink. Other route query errors are still reported.
